task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the closest smaller number than n.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ClosestSmallerThanN(a: array<int>, n: int) returns (result: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned value is the largest number in the input array that is strictly less than n
    - If no such number exists, result is assigned a default value (e.g., 0 or a specified sentinel) and the method's behavior should specify this case accordingly
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method ClosestSmaller(n: int, a: array<int>) returns (result: int?)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The array should not be null
    - The array can be empty; in that case, result is null
    
Dafny specification:
    requires a != null
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - If the array contains at least one element smaller than n, result is the largest such element
    - If no such element exists, result is null
    
Dafny specification:
    ensures (exists x :: x in a[..] && x < n) ==> (result != null && result in a[..] && result < n && forall y :: y in a[..] && y < n ==> y <= result)
    ensures (forall y :: y in a[..] && y < n ==> y <= result) // If result is not null, it is the largest number less than n
    ensures result == null <==> (forall y :: y in a[..] ==> y >= n)
  
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method ClosestSmaller(n: int, a: array<int>) returns (result: int?)
    requires a != null
    ensures (exists x :: x in a[..] && x < n) ==> (result != null && result in a[..] && result < n && forall y :: y in a[..] && y < n ==> y <= result)
    ensures (forall y :: y in a[..] && y < n ==> y <= result)
    ensures result == null <==> (forall y :: y in a[..] ==> y >= n)
{
    var candidate: int? := null;
    var i := 0;
    while i < a.Length
        invariant 0 <= i <= a.Length
        invariant (exists x :: x in a[..i] && x < n) ==> (candidate != null && candidate in a[..i] && candidate < n && forall y :: y in a[..i] && y < n ==> y <= candidate)
        invariant (forall y :: y in a[..i] ==> y >= n) ==> candidate == null
        invariant (candidate != null) ==> candidate in a[..i]
    {
        if a[i] < n {
            if candidate == null || a[i] > candidate {
                candidate := a[i];
            }
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
    result := candidate;
}
```
